title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: The complete manuscript incorporates a quantitative angular stability theorem for unequal root push-outs, with an explicit packing example. The unrestricted cases (G) and (C) remain open.
